sources.title: Simple and Controllable Music Generation
sources.inspection: A complete token-pattern SVG, not a whole architecture. Repeated square cells show temporal ordering; multi-codebook patterns are not transferred. This is cross-track construction grammar only. Same-track SVG architecture references for a figure-generation workflow were not available in the retained evidence. No music/speech internals are transferred.
